mechanism.claim: After a daily close-envelope extreme displacement enters its causal upper tail, a same-direction return inside that tail on the next completed UTC day marks normalization of an unsupported intraday excursion; during elevated variation, follow the reversal for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long after same-direction downside-displacement tail reentry; short after upside-displacement tail reentry
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCVFR is a two-day daily tail-reentry transition. HVCEDR trades the current four-hour tail state directly and failed novelty without opening outcomes; HVCVFR neither reuses its event set nor changes its clock/threshold. It is also not path-ordered drawup/drawdown, wick/body geometry, OI, funding, or a fitted channel.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: daily same-direction close-envelope displacement tail reentries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.current_auction: 1,440 exact coherent BTCUSDT one-minute OHLC rows over [D-24h,D)
features.prior_close_envelope: highest and lowest last close from the 22 uninterrupted completed UTC-day auctions ending at D-24h; current auction excluded
features.dominant_displacement: strictly larger positive displacement; ties or two nonpositive values invalid
features.displacement_rank: strict-prior midrank of dominant displacement over at most 270 source-valid days; current excluded; minimum 180
features.tail_reentry: immediately previous source-valid day rank>=0.80, current rank<0.80, and current dominant side exactly equals previous dominant side; missing predecessor invalid
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 1,440 coherent BTCUSDT rows [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid days; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: 23 uninterrupted coherent UTC days including current, one strict same-direction tail reentry, and variation rank pass at D; no OI, funding, premium, alt, or post-decision condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no UTC day, prior-close envelope, displacement formula, rank history, tail reentry, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
